Urease is an enzyme that breaks down urea in solution to form aqueous ammonia.
Urea in solution is almost neutral. The aqueous ammonia formed increases the pH of the solution.
Plan an investigation to determine the relationship between the concentration of urease and the
• universal indicator solution and a pH colour chart.

Procedure
The student:

• adds some solid H to the dilute sulfuric acid
• tests the gas produced with limewater.

parts.text:
Procedure
The student:
• puts some aqueous sodium hydroxide into a test‑tube
• adds some solid H to the aqueous sodium hydroxide
• warms the mixture
• tests the gas produced with damp red litmus paper.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
The damp red litmus paper turns blue.
State the name of the gas produced.

parts.text:
Tick (3) the name of the cation (positive ion) present in H.
ammonium calcium
copper zinc
